properties.decision_summary: Chose one oneLine() normaliser — collapse \s+ to a space, trim, strip URL userinfo, cap with an ellipsis, blank → absent — applied to EVERY free-text field the working-set renderer emits, with two caps: RESULT_RENDER_MAX 240 for observation-derived text and PROSE_RENDER_MAX 500 for ruling statement, decision summary/rationale, post summary and entity name
